title: Clear Kayak Tour of Sand Harbor's Crystal Clear Waters
includes: Clear Kayaks, Light Weight Carbon fiber Paddles, NRS ion Lifejackets, and Dry Bags
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

Weight & Equipment Limits For your safety, all equipment has manufacturer weight limits: * Clear Kayaks: calm conditions: single person 285 or 350 lbs per boat, bumpy conditions single person 240 lbs, 300 lbs per boat. Guests exceeding posted limits may be unable to participate. In such cases, we will do our best to offer an alternative (different equipment/activity, store credit, or reschedule), but refunds are not guaranteed.
policies: Wind can cause wavy conditions. Afternoons have a higher chance of being windy. We recommend booking mornings or flexibility into your travel schedule in case weather becomes a factor.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
All of our guides are Lifeguard Certified with the American Red Cross and guests may choose to swim on our tours ;-)

We provide Light Weight Fully Carbon Fiber Paddles for enhanced user experience.

Weave Large granite boulders and gaze upon crystal clear turquoise shallows and cobalt blue depths.

On warmer days guests may to swim, scale up Bonzai, and leap into the water for a more thrilling adventure.

Guides capture stunning photos.

We are allowed to launch a maximum of 6 kayaks on any given tour. On tours with more than six guests booked, guests of the same family will be asked to paddle in pairs. Guests desiring kayaks for themselves should choose tours with less than six total guests.
Larger groups must request accommodation three weeks in advance and be granted permission from the state park.
